tx:
The following actions will give a chance to drop this pet:
• planting seeds
• harvesting resources
• checking the health of a patch
• foraging berry bushes or mushroom clusters in the Arc
• planting or harvesting crystal trees
• destroying seeds using the seedicide
• at the Player-owned Farm or Ranch out of Time by
• gathering animal produce 
• mucking out manure
• curing diseases
• doing the Palm Tree Farming activity at The Beach
The following actions will not give a chance to drop this pet:
• Playing a Minigame that rewards experience in this skill

Gaining this item is based on the amount of experience awarded at once; the more experience granted per item made, the greater the chance of gaining this pet. The chance is not affected by experience boosters.
In a purely mathematical format, the chance f of receiving the pet on any particular action is
f = \frac{(B / 12) \times S}{50,000,000}
Where:
• B is the base experience per action
• S is the virtual skill level. At 200 million experience, a flat bonus of 200 is applied to this value
